title: Nearby-cycle specialization is a cohomological comparison
statement:
Use the finite coefficient conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions] and the nearby-cycle specialization datum of [def-trf-deformation-specialization]. Let $c:C\to X\times_kX$ be a correspondence of separated finite-type $k$-schemes and let $\widetilde c:\widetilde C\to\widetilde X\times_D\widetilde X$ be any separated finite-type lift over $D=\operatorname{Spec}(k[t]_{(t)})$, with special fibre $b$. Put $F=\operatorname{Fix}(c)$ and define the fixed-locus lift $\widetilde F:=\widetilde C\times_{\widetilde X\times_D\widetilde X,\,\widetilde c,\,\widetilde\Delta}\widetilde X$ using the diagonal $\widetilde\Delta$; its special fibre is the fixed scheme of $b$. Assume the specified exceptional operations are admissible and work on the bounded constructible finite-Tor etale representatives of [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin], using the transported pro-etale operation datum of [def-fix-six-functor-datum] for the project version. The lift induces a cohomological comparison from $c$ to $b$ in the sense of [def-trf-cohomological-comparison]. Its object functors are $f_Z=\operatorname{sp}_{\widetilde Z}$, including $f_F=\operatorname{sp}_{\widetilde F}$ for the fixed-locus object. Its tensor map is the lax tensor map of $i^*Rj_*$, its $\alpha_g,\beta_g$ and their mates are the ordinary and exceptional nearby-cycle comparisons, and $f_s=\operatorname{id}$ with $\iota=\operatorname{id}_A$. In particular these functors preserve the stated finite-Tor constructible categories, and the evaluation-defined duality comparison $f_ZD_ZM\to D_{Z_0}f_ZM$ is an isomorphism.

More precisely, there exists a proper morphism of lifts $\widetilde c'\to\widetilde c$ that is the identity on the generic correspondence $c$, such that $\widetilde c'$ extends to a correspondence proper over $D$ lifting a compactification of $c$. The comparison of the preceding paragraph is canonically the composite of the compactifiable specialization comparison $c\to b'=\widetilde c'_0$ and the compactifiable proper-direct-image comparison $b'\to b$. No properness of the original lift or of $c$ is required. The maps on the special fibre and the functorial identifications in this composite are the actual nearby-cycle proper-base-change maps, not arbitrary choices of isomorphisms.
